summary: Use an invented observing place to connect intimate human-scale instruments with an expansive sky composition.
objective: The observatory remains navigable in the dark, and decorative stars or orbital motifs are identified as invented when appropriate.
intent_signals: Set the scene in a celestial observatory fiction
Use cosmic observatory as the narrative setting
example_prompts: Build a fictional celestial observatory with an inspectable telescope and explicitly decorative sky motifs.

principles: Use an invented observing place to connect intimate human-scale instruments with an expansive sky composition.
Theme supplies setting and motifs; choose geometry style, rendering approach and factual model independently.
implementation: Compose platforms, viewing apertures and a focal instrument with distinct silhouettes; decide whether celestial forms are symbolic or data-driven.
Use a restrained dark field and selected luminous accents while keeping stairs, rails and controls visible.
Offer an instrument-level view and a sky-oriented view; symbolic orbits may animate, but sourced astronomical views must use their own frame/time contract.
observable_checks: The observatory remains navigable in the dark, and decorative stars or orbital motifs are identified as invented when appropriate.
Inspect one focal object close up and the complete route or spatial relationship from an overview.

known_limits: Authored fictional setting guidance; no rendered artifact or runtime improvement has been observed for this record.
This proposal does not establish historical, cultural, scientific or engineering facts.
creative_affordances: Combine with surreal, minimalist or glass-like forms; a celestial theme alone does not establish accurate positions, scales or seasons.
Replace motifs or combine settings to suit the user brief; maintain a readable organizing idea rather than treating these suggestions as a fixed asset list.
